prompt_text: Refactor this batch job so it only re-processes records changed since the last run instead of the full table every night.
Write a Python script that pulls the hourly carbon intensity of the local grid and delays non-urgent training jobs until intensity drops below a threshold.
Add pagination to the admin user list. It currently loads all 400k rows.
Our onboarding flow has 14 required fields. Rewrite it so a new user can finish in under a minute, and explain what you dropped and why.
Make this image pipeline serve WebP with responsive sizes so mobile users on metered connections download less data.
Help me write a deprecation plan for the v1 API so integrators have a year to migrate and our on-call load drops.
Add an offline mode to the field data collection app. Enumerators work in areas with no coverage for hours at a time.
Rewrite these error messages so they are readable by someone who is not a developer, and add screen reader labels to the form.
Set up autoscaling so the staging cluster scales to zero overnight and on weekends.
Our team spends two days a month on manual release notes. Write a tool that drafts them from merged pull requests.

Review this Dockerfile and cut the image size. Builds take eleven minutes and the CI bill is getting attention from finance.

```
FROM node:20
COPY . .
RUN npm install
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
```
Add a dark theme to the dashboard.
Write a migration that adds a soft-delete column and backfills it without locking the table during business hours.

Explain what this regular expression matches.

```
^(?:[a-z0-9!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+)@(?:[a-z0-9-]+\.)+[a-z]{2,}$
```
Build a queue so on-call engineers stop being paged for retryable failures at night.
Add a consent banner that stores no analytics identifiers until the user opts in.

Optimise this SQL query. It runs on every page load and does a full scan of a 90 million row table.

```
SELECT * FROM events WHERE lower(source) = 'web' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50;
```
Rename the variables in this function to something clearer for the next maintainer.
We want to run inference on-device rather than in the cloud so the app works on older phones and sends less telemetry. Sketch the approach.
Add a rate limiter to the public API to keep one bad client from degrading service for everyone else.
Write a cron job that emails me the daily signup count.
Replace the third-party charting library with a smaller one. The bundle is 1.4 MB and our users are mostly on 3G.
Document the architecture of this service so a new hire can be productive without shadowing someone for a week.
